notes.text: Complete second reading finished. No candidate change, material finding, certainty-only alteration, MARKS decision update, inventory addition, or removed/narrowed doubt is proposed.

All six equation rows, ten low wedge indices, twelve pi-one graphs, eighteen covered X graphs, the brace structures, three B-gamma map connectors, cancellation states, prose, four original MARKS, and both pencil numerals were checked. Glyph/encoding confirmations are not new material rows.

The accepted singular celle qu'on cherche est, later plural celles, short iso. and hom, point-free ens and op, extra parentheses in the second J equation, and four final points are retained as written. The manuscript wording is not normalized.

The minute isolated point at approximately native (1072,248), lower-right of the first displayed E, was visible in the existing first-display crop. Its size is markedly smaller than ordinary prose punctuation; it was not promoted to a new stop. No crop was reopened or made for it.
The two pencil numerals remain attributed to an unassigned pencil hand. No date is present. H's editorial page and operator commentary is not inserted as source text.

Only this page's original, native halves, packet, accepted fragment/report and the ten listed existing crops were used, together with the authorized audit contract, reading guidelines and current notation table. No other page image, OCR, research or TeX compilation was used.

Insertion-guide check: no live interlinear insertion accompanied by a separate guide or caret was identified in the completed original/half views. The detached stroke above the first Aut is already represented by its accent/capital-formation alternative, and the strokes below it belong to the cancelled index. No guide was omitted by an inserted wrapper on this page.
